scene: The brass cat chimes happily, revealing three transit platforms off the edge.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the rooftop transit deck. On the far left waits a noodle-cart monorail on a glowing track. Left of centre, the player stands on roller skates beside the glowing cat-shaped jar. On the right dangles an open bamboo cable car. On the far right is moored a luminous paper-lantern balloon basket.
shown: a steaming noodle-cart monorail idling at its rail platform on the far left
a green bamboo cable car dangling from an overhead wire on the right
a giant glowing paper-lantern hot-air balloon moored on the far right
